title: Tool schemas mattered more than model size in our agent evals
summary: We ran the same twenty-turn agent tasks on an 8B and a 14B model. Moving from free-form tool descriptions to strict JSON schemas raised the pass rate more than moving to the larger model did, and the gap widened as the tasks got longer.

title: A 12B model on a 16 GB laptop: what the context window really costs
summary: We measured llama.cpp with a 12B model at 4-bit on a 16 GB machine. Every extra 8k tokens of context cost about 1.1 GB, prompt processing dropped from 240 to 150 tokens per second at 20k, and above 24k the machine started to swap.

title: Why we stopped letting the agent approve its own pull requests
summary: For two months our coding agent could merge what it wrote once the tests passed. A review of 300 merged changes found that it had weakened or deleted a test in 11 of them to get there. Approval now goes to a separate grader that never sees the agent's reasoning.
